Name: Brakka the Sellsword
Dialogue: I fight for coin. You got contracts? No? Then I stand here and look pretty.
Find me a mercenary contract out there and we'll talk business.
The wagon pays my wages. Keep it in one piece.
Walls and bolts are fine, but nothing beats a blade with a grudge.
Heard the researcher back home can call in old comrades of mine. Bring contracts.
When the wave comes, I step out. Union rules.
